functions.label: Mobilisation

functions.label: Knowledge recombination
functions.definition: Bringing different situated and technical knowledge into a collective response.

episodes.title: Agreeing how to restore the Ortube
episodes.demand: Preserve a wooden fishing boat and coordinate the final phase of its restoration.
episodes.reportedResponse: Bermeo Town Council reports that a collaboration agreement was signed on 27 March 2023. It assigns distinct administrative, financial, technical and practical roles.
episodes.reportedContinuity: The signed agreement had a stated two-year term. Interview 0021 separately describes long-running volunteer work and uncertainty about future management. Neither source establishes completion or navigability.

participants.role: Signatory, boat owner and administrative and budget manager
Signatory; assigned execution of recovery work
Signatory; assigned technical direction via Erain
Its managing director is listed among the signatories

evidence.englishSummary: The municipal notice names Bermeo Town Council, the Provincial Council, the Ortube association and Itsasmuseum; it also lists the managing director of Bizkaikoa among the signers. It reports the town council owns the boat and will manage the project administratively and financially.

evidence.quote: una inversión de 190.000 euros destinados a la financiación de parte de los trabajos
evidence.englishSummary: The council notice reports €190,000 of provincial support for part of the restoration work; this is not a total project cost or verified disbursement.
Itsasmuseum is assigned technical direction through Erain and preparation of a restoration and maintenance plan; the association is assigned implementation.

evidence.quote: Konbenio bat eginda Udaletxeagaz, Aldundiagaz eta Bilboko Museo Maritimogaz.
evidence.englishSummary: The participant describes an agreement involving the town council, the provincial council and the Bilbao Maritime Museum.

functionalReadings.interpretation: The agreement aligns distinct responsibilities around the same restoration undertaking.
The agreement brings institutional funding and technical resources to an ongoing community undertaking.

support.meaning: Reported provincial contribution towards part of the restoration work; not total cost, cash-disbursement verification or new proposal.

episodes.title: Students and volunteers work on the Ortube
episodes.demand: Continue practical restoration while offering real work for vocational training.
episodes.reportedResponse: In November 2025 the council reported 15 vocational students taking part in weekly restoration work under teacher and project volunteer supervision.
episodes.reportedContinuity: The council describes this arrangement as being in its third year. The notice does not identify the individuals or establish the boat’s eventual completion.

participants.role: Vocational school: reported student cohort and teaching supervision
Project volunteers: supervise restoration tasks alongside school staff

evidence.quote: 15 estudiantes de Formación Profesional Básica participan activamente en la iniciativa
evidence.englishSummary: Fifteen students are reported as active in the initiative.
The municipality reports one working day per week, with students applying classroom learning under teacher and volunteer supervision; this collaboration is in its third year.

functionalReadings.interpretation: A recurring schedule and shared supervision connect school learning to restoration work.
Classroom knowledge is applied alongside practical supervision in a joint task. This is evidence of practical integration; reciprocal exchange or joint design is not documented.

episodes.title: Sustaining the 30 December gathering
episodes.demand: Maintain an annual community gathering at San Juan de Gaztelugatxe.
episodes.reportedResponse: An interviewee describes small local businesses contributing money to volunteers, who organise food for the public gathering alongside music and dance.
episodes.reportedContinuity: The source describes a recurring tradition and a perceived change under tourist pressure. It does not identify the businesses or volunteers by name or specify which years this arrangement operated.

participants.role: Unnamed volunteers receive contributions and organise the food

evidence.quote: Herriko enpresa txikiek diru bat ematen diete boluntarioei eta merendola bat egiten da herritarrentzat.
evidence.englishSummary: Local small businesses give money to volunteers, and a communal snack is organised for residents.

evidence.quote: Bertara joaten gara, bertan trikitixa jotzen da, dantzak egiten dira, eta modu kolektiboan merendola bat egiten da.
evidence.englishSummary: The speaker describes going there, music and dance, and the collective preparation of food.

functionalReadings.interpretation: The gathering activates volunteer labour and local financial contributions.
The account describes an arrangement linking resource contributors to volunteers who organise a common activity.

episodes.title: Public talk convened by Guggenheim Urdaibai Stop
episodes.demand: Provide information and create a public occasion to compare views on the proposed extension.
episodes.reportedResponse: A selected listening excerpt reports that the platform held a talk where opinions could be compared and information was shared.
episodes.reportedContinuity: A separate source reports learning about the issue through the platform. It does not say the speaker attended this talk or establish an outcome of it.

participants.role: Platform reported as convening the talk
Audience implied by the comparison of views; no participant names or affiliations supplied

evidence.quote: Hemen egon zen Guggenheim Stop Plataformako hitzaldi bat, eta hor iritziak kontrastatu ahal izan ziren, egon zan ahalegin bat informazinoa emoteko.
evidence.englishSummary: The platform held a talk here; people could compare views and there was an effort to provide information.

evidence.quote: La información es nula, porque nosotros nos enteramos por la plataforma [Stop Urdaibai] pero si no, no hay información.
evidence.englishSummary: A different interviewee describes the platform as their information channel. This is contextual evidence, not evidence of attendance.

functionalReadings.interpretation: The platform convened a public space around a shared issue. The comparison of views is reported, but no synthesis or jointly revised response is documented.

episodes.initiativeLinkBasis: Analyst contextual linkage: the convening platform is listed in the K-tool opposition campaign; the API does not link this specific talk to the project record.

episodes.title: Revising the narrative profiles in Ibarrangelu
episodes.demand: Check whether the initial narrative profiles cover the range of territorial perspectives.
episodes.reportedResponse: The report records a session with 11 participants. Four profiles were discussed; the group identified the need for an additional profile, 002.
episodes.reportedContinuity: A later Murueta session reviewed five profiles. The report documents an analytical revision, not an implementation commitment.

participants.role: Reported organiser of the wider sensemaking process; no individual attendee inferred

evidence.quote: Participaron el alcalde del Ayuntamiento y representantes del Gobierno Vasco, la plataforma Guggenheim Urdaibai Stop (GUS), Gernika Gogoratuz, la entidad Elika y la UPV
evidence.englishSummary: The report names the mayor and the participating institutions and groups; other individual roles are also listed in the source.

evidence.quote: entre los participantes salió a la luz la necesidad de crear el perfil 002.
evidence.englishSummary: Participants identified the need for profile 002.

functionalReadings.interpretation: Participants from different settings tested the original analytical categories and produced a documented revision.
The session brought several kinds of territorial actors into a common review, including actors with distinct institutional and civic roles.

episodes.displayNote: Named graph nodes represent organisations or roles, not a complete count of attendees.

episodes.title: Contrasting five profiles in Bermeo
episodes.demand: Test the revised listening profiles in a further local sensemaking session.
episodes.reportedResponse: The final report records a 14-participant session at the Casa de Cultura in Bermeo. It says that five profiles were contrasted.
episodes.reportedContinuity: This was part of a sequence of sessions; the report passage does not attribute a new profile or action commitment to this session.

evidence.quote: Esta sesión contó con la participación de la primera Vicelehendakari del Gobierno Vasco.
evidence.englishSummary: The report notes the participation of the first Vice-Lehendakari; the same paragraph names the mayor and representatives or members of GUS, UNESCO Etxea and LAB.
Five profiles were contrasted at the session.

functionalReadings.interpretation: The gathering activated a different mix of public and civic actors around the same listening work.

episodes.interpretiveBoundary: The source reports that five profiles were discussed; there is no documented analytical revision to code as knowledge recombination.

episodes.title: Pooling housing access through Ankurkulu
episodes.demand: Make dwelling use available to cooperative members through a collective tenure arrangement.
episodes.reportedResponse: K-tool describes collective ownership and non-profit use rights. The Basque register confirms the cooperative’s purpose; REAS reports that Ankurkulu participants presented their experience of an inhabited cooperative in Mendata.
episodes.reportedContinuity: The sources support an enacted collective tenure arrangement. They do not establish individual affordability gains, cash flows or informal care exchanges.

time.label: Reported inhabited; start date not specified in the evidence used

participants.role: Registered housing cooperative and collective resource holder
Resident members using housing through the cooperative; no individuals modelled

evidence.englishSummary: The project record describes cooperative self-management, collective ownership and use rights without a profit purpose.

evidence.quote: PROCURAR PARA SUS SOCIOS A PRECIO DE COSTE Y EN REGIMEN DE CESION DE USO VIVIENDAS
evidence.englishSummary: The registry specifies access to housing at cost for members, through a right-of-use arrangement.
REAS reports a first-hand account by Ankurkulu participants of an inhabited right-of-use housing cooperative in Mendata.

functionalReadings.interpretation: Collective ownership and use rights form a durable shared resource through which members make housing access available to one another. This code is about the tenure arrangement, not interpersonal care.
Cooperative tenure links collective ownership with individual use through a common arrangement. The sources do not detail internal decisions or governance routines.

designPrinciple: Activities reveal situated functional configurations. Portfolio reading compares and connects these configurations; it does not assign a single capacity score to a group.
